title: Average balance calculated
description: This event is triggered when the average balance for an account is successfully calculated for the specified date range and selected balance types.

begin_date_datetime.title: Begin date datetime
begin_date_datetime.description: The starting datetime of the period for which the average balance was calculated.

end_date_datetime.title: End date datetime
end_date_datetime.description: The end datetime of the period for which the average balance was calculated.

balance_types_to_calculate.title: Balance types to calculate
balance_types_to_calculate.description: List of balances you select for calculating its average balance.

average_balance.title: Average balance
average_balance.description: The average balance calculated for the specified period.

created_at.title: Created at datetime
created_at.description: Datetime when the average balance calculation started

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 Currency code for the average balance

update_at.title: Update at datetime
update_at.description: The datetime when the average balance was last completed.

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: Custom account ID used to identify the account within your organization. This value links the Pismo account to your internal account identifier.

balance_types.title: balance types to calculate
balance_types.description: The balance type selected for calculating the average balance.
